payload.title: The typeorm adapter decides whether an @Entity declares a schema from the syntax of the options literal (a property named schema exists), not from the value TypeORM evaluates, so schema: undefined and schema: '' are reported as pinned while computed-key, spread and identifier options are invisible
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.ts:905-925 (the options object is used only when an argument is an object literal; schemaDeclared is declaresProperty, a presence test)
tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.ts:1111-1117 (declaresProperty counts a property assignment or shorthand with any initializer and never a spread assignment)
tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.ts:1169-1174 (isPropertyNamed accepts identifier, string and numeric keys only, so ['schema'] never matches)
tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.ts:435-455 (forbidden fires on schemaDeclared alone, with a message saying the schema pins every tenant's rows)
tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.tool.json:45-54 (premise 1 of the rule is stated as 'declares a schema option, literal or not')
e2e/tests/integration/schema-invariants.spec.ts:134-138 (this repository names schema: undefined as a legitimate shape of a per-tenant entity)
payload.rule_violated: ADR-011 (a per-tenant table omits schema so search_path routes it); CLAUDE.md: a detector must not report what the framework does not do, and must name what it cannot read
payload.notes: A per-tenant entity written @Entity('t', { schema: undefined }) or { schema: '' } is reported HIGH typeorm_entity_schema_forbidden, although TypeORM's EntityMetadata takes the schema only when it is truthy (node_modules/typeorm/metadata/EntityMetadata.js line 577), so no rows are pinned and the message is false. The reverse miss: @Entity('t', { ['schema']: 'hr' }), @Entity('t', { ...base }) where base carries schema, and @Entity('t', opts) leave schemaDeclared false, so a pinned per-tenant table produces no forbidden finding, and an infrastructure table written the same way is told by typeorm_entity_schema_required that it declares no literal schema. A count over every @Entity( call under apps/ at this revision finds 375 calls and none with these shapes, so nothing is wrong today. Close condition: Make schemaDeclared mean what TypeORM evaluates (false for undefined, null and the empty string) and report options the adapter cannot read (identifier options, spread, computed keys) as a named observation instead of treating them as absent; closed when typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.forbidden.test.ts has cases for schema: undefined, schema: '', ['schema'], a spread and an identifier options argument with the stated outcomes. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
